description.value: A small, family-operated oceanfront motel built in 1960, perched on Dallas Road with 180-degree views of the snow-capped Olympic Mountains across the Strait of Juan de Fuca. All rooms include kitchenettes, oceanfront balconies, and free off-street parking. The motel is within walking distance of Victoria's Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park, and sits on a main bus route.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 59m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and rich with detail. It confirms the OSM address (290 Dallas Road, Victoria BC V8V 1A6), local phone (250-386-3305), and email. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated on the accommodations page ('Free Wi-Fi' listed as a room amenity, corroborated by OSM internet_access=wlan). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Motel is closed for winter months (November, December, January, February) — seasonal operation not reflected in OSM tags.
Website lists a toll-free number (1-888-738-3399) not present in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable motel with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. Seasonally closed November–February but otherwise open.

wow_evidence: family-operated oceanfront motel built in 1960... 180-degree views of the snow-capped Olympic Mountains
